projects.title: Creator Retention Podcast — First 2 Seconds Hook
projects.statusMessage: Generated 6 viral clips ready for editing.
projects.fullTranscript: Stop posting 60-minute podcasts without cutting them into vertical hooks first. Here is the brutal truth most creators ignore. 90% of your audience decides whether to stay in the first two seconds. If your opening line sounds like a slow introduction, viewers swipe immediately. Instead, open with a bold, contrarian takeaway, highlight every power word with dynamic captions, and lock the camera onto the speaker. That single shift doubled our watch-through rate on Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok in 30 days. Now let's break down the exact three-step retention framework every top creator uses right now.
